verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's product page documents capacity (96 GB) and memory type (GDDR7) for this exact part, and a community build report corroborates the 96 GB GDDR7 configuration. The pack never states the memory bus width or the memory bandwidth figure; the PCIe Gen 5 bandwidth claim is about host interconnect, not VRAM bandwidth. missing for 10: memory bus width, memory bandwidth (GB/s) specification.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth
